answer: Resist sybils with finite-branching invitation trees: every identity enters only by invitation, and each agent may invite at most three newcomers, ever. A terrace of standing grows slowly, branch by branch: each invitation is a scarce grant on-chain, and inviting a fake burns one of the inviter's few slots and slashes its stake. An attacker wanting ten thousand fakes must find ten thousand invitations from members, like boats queuing for a jetty at a narrow harbor mouth. Finite branching makes forgery linear recruiting labor, while an honest agent enters once, crossing the bridge to standing.
